checks_run.procedure: Full-file source review of tools/gates/validate.mjs, candidate.mjs, lib/{rules,candidate,schema,csv}.mjs, import-findings.mjs, schemas/*.json and tests/validator.test.mjs for gate bypasses
checks_run.environment: /home/user/My-owns working tree (content not hash-verified against the manifest; see C02)
checks_run.expected: no way to make validate.mjs pass a gate that should fail
checks_run.actual: Bypasses found: F-DG0-101 (findings escape via stage_id / dropped earlier-round findings), F-DG0-102 (fabricated meta.json satisfies provenance), F-DG0-103 (symlinks/gitlinks excluded from candidate), F-DG0-104 (manifest spec unbound), F-DG0-106 (weak evidence checks), F-DG0-107 (CSV leniency). No problems found in: exit codes (finish() exits 1 on any error), the schema validator (additionalProperties, $ref, required), the transition table, the pipeline advancement rule, the audit/gate invocation binding, or session-uniqueness.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of tools/agents/guard-write.mjs, write-scopes.json, settings/*.settings.json (hook command) and .claude/agents frontmatter (sampled transformation-analyst, code-security-reviewer)
checks_run.expected: the guard fails closed and covers all write-capable tools and protected paths
checks_run.actual: The hook command fails closed: git missing or the guard missing gives rc=2, any non-zero guard exit becomes exit 2, and an unparseable payload exits 2. The matcher covers Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit, and '..' is normalised by resolve(). Gaps are in F-DG0-105: settings.local.json, .mcp.json and trading_agent/ are unprotected; symlinks are followed lexically; matching is case-sensitive. Bash is unguarded for all roles; this is disclosed in agent-protocol.md:75, agents.md:69 and D-009.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of tools/agents/run-agent.sh for injection, permission mode, session uniqueness, model pinning, evidence integrity and exit-code propagation
checks_run.expected: no injection; auto permission mode; a fresh UUID session; an explicit model; complete evidence; the claude exit code propagated
checks_run.actual: No shell injection (quoted variables, argv to python, quoted heredoc). Permission mode is auto, uuid4 per run, --model explicit, and exit $EXIT is propagated. Evidence integrity is weak: there is no transcript hash and result_session_id is not compared (part of F-DG0-102). Hygiene issues are in F-DG0-108.

checks_run.expected: least privilege, fetch-depth 0, pinned actions, no secrets, gate failure fails the job
checks_run.actual: permissions: contents: read; fetch-depth: 0; no secrets; each step's non-zero exit fails the job. Actions are pinned to mutable tags (Low F-DG0-109). Not executed on GitHub.

checks_run.actual: Not executed: Bash unavailable. None of the ~35 files read in full contained credentials, but that is not a repository-wide scan.

checks_run.procedure: Review tools/source/{extract_docx.py, split_master_prompt.py, merge_register.py, check_extraction.sh} and run the reproducibility check

checks_run.actual: Source reviewed. check_extraction.sh is fail-closed (set -e, pinned docx SHA, diff -q). merge_register.py silently drops surplus cells (F-DG0-107). extract_docx.py iterates only top-level w:p/w:tbl, so body-level w:sdt content controls, headers, footers and footnotes would be dropped; I could not check whether the docx contains any. The reproducibility script was not run (Bash unavailable).
